title: Compatible-tower composition commutes with proper refinements
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and use $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for schemes $T$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and open extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{h}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms. For $
u=1,2$, suppose given a compatible tower [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower]
$$Y\xrightarrow{i_
u} ar Y_
u\xrightarrow{q_
u}Z,\qquad X\xrightarrow{a_
u} ar X_
u\xrightarrow{p_
u} ar Y_
u,$$
where $i_
u,a_
u$ are quasi-compact open immersions, $q_
u,p_
u$ are proper, $q_
u i_
u=h$ and $p_
u a_
u=i_
u f$. Put $U_
u= ar X_
u	imes_{ ar Y_
u}Y$ with projections $b_
u:U_
u	o ar X_
u$ and $p_{Y,
u}:U_
u	o Y$. Let $c_
u:X	o U_
u$ be the induced quasi-compact open immersion, so that $b_
u c_
u=a_
u$ and $p_{Y,
u}c_
u=f$. Suppose proper maps $u: ar Y_1	o ar Y_2$, $v: ar X_1	o ar X_2$, $w:U_1	o U_2$ satisfy
$$ui_1=i_2,\quad va_1=a_2,\quad wc_1=c_2,\quad vb_1=b_2w,\quad p_2v=up_1,\quad p_{Y,2}w=p_{Y,1},\quad q_2u=q_1.$$
For every proper/open square use the normalized comparison $\gamma$ of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], and for proper refinements write $\alpha_u,\alpha_v,\alpha_w$ for [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison]. Set
$$F_
u=Rp_{Y,
u,*}c_{
u!},\quad H_
u=Rq_{
u,*}i_{
u!},\quad E_
u=R(q_
u p_
u)_*a_{
u!}.$$
Let $\gamma_
u:i_{
u!}Rp_{Y,
u,*}	o Rp_{
u,*}b_{
u!}$ be the comparison for the tower square. Define
$$\mu_
u:H_
u F_
u\xrightarrow{Rq_{
u,*}\gamma_
u c_{
u!}}Rq_{
u,*}Rp_{
u,*}b_{
u!}c_{
u!}\xrightarrow{\sim}E_
u,$$
using the canonical ordinary etale bounded-below direct-image composition isomorphisms with their identity and triple-composition coherence [lem-cbc-etale-derived-direct-image-coherence] and the degreewise exact open-extension composition isomorphism [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition, lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]. Put
$$C_f=Rp_{Y,2,*}\alpha_w:F_2	o F_1,\quad C_h=Rq_{2,*}\alpha_u:H_2	o H_1,\quad C_{hf}=R(q_2p_2)_*\alpha_v:E_2	o E_1,$$
with the same direct-image composition identifications. Then, as natural transformations $H_2F_2	o E_1$,
$$C_{hf}\circ\mu_2=\mu_1\circ(C_hF_1)\circ(H_2C_f).$$
The square $vb_1=b_2w$ need not be cartesian. No Noetherian, quasi-compact or quasi-separated hypothesis is imposed on $X,Y,Z$ beyond the supplied tower data.
